en.headline: Police still probing two-year-old's head injury at Kowloon Tong kindergarten
en.dek: Officers returned to Cannan Kindergarten on Waterloo Road on Monday to collect CCTV, the school said, after earlier claiming the case had been closed.
body: Hong Kong police have said an investigation into a head injury suffered by a two-year-old boy remains open, despite the kindergarten previously stating that officers had found no evidence the child was hurt on campus.

Cannan Kindergarten (Waterloo Road) in Kowloon Tong said police officers returned to the school on Monday to collect CCTV recordings. The school said it had preserved all relevant records and footage and would continue to hand over material as requested, adding that it had been fully cooperating with the inquiry and had reviewed the materials itself.

The case first came to light earlier this month when the boy's parents complained that he had been sent home with a large bump on the back of his head. The Education Bureau ordered the school to submit a report on the incident. The school had told media that police reviewed CCTV and closed the case after finding no sign of injury on the premises.
No one has been charged. The investigation continues.

zh.headline: 九龍塘幼稚園兩歲男童頭部受傷警方仍在調查
zh.dek: 迦南幼稚園（窩打老道）稱警方周一再返回學校取走閉路電視片段，較早前該校曾指案件已結。
body: 香港警方表示，一宗涉及兩歲男童頭部受傷的調查仍在進行，儘管幼稚園較早前稱警方已檢視閉路電視並未發現兒童在校園內受傷的證據。
位於九龍塘的迦南幼稚園（窩打老道）表示，警方周一返回學校收取閉路電視錄影。校方稱已妥善保存所有相關記錄及片段，並會按要求繼續提供資料，同時表示一直全力配合調查並已自行檢視有關材料。
事件於本月較早時曝光，男童家長投訴孩子放學後頭頂後出現大腫塊。教育局已要求學校提交事件報告。校方曾向傳媒表示，警方檢視閉路電視後未發現校園內有受傷跡象，案件已結。
目前無人被控。調查仍在進行。
